briefdescription.para: Writes to the serial flash connected to the SPI interface.

detaileddescription.para: The flash contains a 256 byte write buffer which can be filled and then a write is automatically performed by the device. All the data put into the buffer must be in the same page of the device with page boundaries being on 256 byte boundaries.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the SPI driver component to use.
The address to write data to in the flash.
The number of bytes to write.
The command used to write data to the flash. SPI device supports only Page Program command to write data to the flash.

simplesect.para:
- In XSCT/classic flow, the device configuration is looked up based on DeviceId.
The function calls other functions which contain loops that may be infinite if interrupts are not working such that it may not return. If the device slave select is not correct and the device is not responding on bus it reads a status of 0xFF for the status register as the bus is pulled up.
